title: OpenAI发布Jalapeño芯片：宣称性能与效率超越竞争对手
summary: OpenAI于周二发布博客文章，宣布其新型AI芯片Jalapeño在任务处理效率和响应速度上均优于其他AI系统。在记者简报会上，OpenAI硬件副总裁Richard Ho表示，Jalapeño芯片实现了“两全其美”，即在提升推理速度的同时保持高能效。该芯片针对AI工作负载进行了优化，能够加速模型推理过程，减少延迟，从而支持更复杂的实时应用。OpenAI强调，Jalapeño芯片的基准测试结果显示，其性能显著领先于现有主流AI芯片，且功耗更低。这一发布标志着OpenAI在硬件领域的重大进展，旨在减少对外部芯片供应商的依赖，并推动AI计算能力的自主化。目前，该芯片已进入试产阶段，预计将在未来几年内大规模部署于OpenAI的数据中心。业界认为，Jalapeño芯片的推出可能加剧AI芯片市场的竞争，对英伟达等现有厂商构成挑战。
summary_en: OpenAI announced its new AI chip, Jalapeño, in a blog post on Tuesday, claiming it outperforms other AI systems in both task efficiency and response speed. During a press briefing, Richard Ho, OpenAI's vice president of hardware, said the chip offers the 'best of both worlds,' balancing high inference speed with energy efficiency. The chip is optimized for AI workloads, reducing latency and enabling more complex real-time applications. Benchmark results reportedly show significant performance gains over existing mainstream AI chips while consuming less power. This move marks OpenAI's major push into hardware, aiming to reduce reliance on external chip suppliers and advance its AI computing autonomy. The chip is currently in trial production, with plans for large-scale deployment in OpenAI's data centers in the coming years. Industry analysts suggest the Jalapeño chip could intensify competition in the AI chip market, posing a challenge to incumbents like Nvidia.
